property_summary: The pastBlockTime should never decrease after a call to fallback because it is set to block.timestamp + 1 in the reference, ensuring it only increases.
After a call to fallback, pastBlockTime must equal block.timestamp + 1.
After any fallback call with exactly 10 ether, pastBlockTime must be strictly greater than the previous pastBlockTime.
After any fallback call with exactly 10 ether, the value of pastBlockTime is always greater than the block.timestamp of the same transaction.
After a fallback call with exactly 10 ether, pastBlockTime is always block.timestamp + 1.
After any state-changing call, pastBlockTime must be greater than the block.timestamp of that call.
The contract must allow sending exactly 10 ether and not revert when doing so.
The state variable pastBlockTime is always strictly less than the current block timestamp after a fallback call with 10 ether.
After any successful fallback call with exactly 10 ether, the state variable pastBlockTime is congruent to (block.timestamp % 15) modulo 15 for the reference contract.
If the fallback is called with 10 ether and block.number % 15 != 0, then after the call, the contract's ether balance (address(c).balance) remains unchanged because no transfer occurs.
After any single call to fallback(), pastBlockTime is always greater than the block timestamp before the call.
After any call to the fallback function, pastBlockTime should equal block.timestamp + 1 (not block.timestamp + 2).
After any call to C that changes pastBlockTime, the new value must be exactly block.timestamp + 1.
After a fallback call that succeeds (msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp > pastBlockTime), pastBlockTime changes by exactly 1 from block.timestamp + 1.
After any call to the fallback that updates pastBlockTime, the new value equals block.timestamp + 1
PastBlockTime must be exactly block.timestamp + 1 after a successful fallback call.
The contract should not transfer its entire balance to the caller more than once every 15 blocks.
The contract should only transfer its entire balance to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0.
The contract never transfers ether when block.number % 15 == 0.
The contract only transfers its entire balance to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0.
After any number of calls, the contract's balance is always a multiple of 10 ether when the last call happened on a block number that is a multiple of 15.
After a fallback call, pastBlockTime must be strictly greater than the block timestamp at the start of the call.
After a failed fallback call, pastBlockTime must remain unchanged.
After a successful fallback call, pastBlockTime must be strictly greater than the block timestamp at the start of the next call.
After a successful fallback call, pastBlockTime must be equal to block.timestamp + 1.
After a successful fallback call that does not trigger the 15th-block transfer, the contract balance must remain unchanged.
